about_the_game:
Motamo – Supporter+ is a special content pack for players who wish to support the development of the game and help fund future features and levels.

Purchasing this DLC does not unlock exclusive content immediately, but it adds a thank-you banner in-game to show your support.
In the future, it may grant access to premium game modes or themed levels not available in the free version.

This DLC is purely optional. It provides no gameplay advantage, but it helps Motamo grow and improve.

🙏 Thank you for supporting an indie project with heart ❤️
